test.create_query: CREATE TABLE map_has_subcolumn_perf (id UInt64, m Map(String, String)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO map_has_subcolumn_perf SELECT number AS id, mapFromArrays( arrayMap(i -> 'k' || toString(i), range(16)), arrayMap(i -> randomString(64), range(16))) AS m FROM numbers_mt(1000000)
